items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: to go out and jam. I used to have to drive Cootie home somtimes. We both had had our little fun. We used to hang out together.

ctx.x: Oh yeah. Cootie. Cootie with Duke. He was, he and I was good friends. Cootie was good. He had his style. I didn't know about I never, nobody plungers until I heard Cootie. Dud used to do a lot of plungers after that too. I remember the time when Ivie Anderson was singing with Duke Ellington and they played the Savoy. Cootie, Freddie Jenkins, I think was in his section, I can't think of the other trumpet player. And, we were on this stand and they were on that stand. Ivie Anderson used to kid them all the time and…
to go out and jam. I used to have to drive Cootie home somtimes. We both had had our little fun. We used to hang out together. We were in the Savoy together years ago.
